title: Contoso APM — Profiler vs EDOT
description: Side-by-side Elastic APM .NET profiler vs EDOT (fixed EDOT volume query).

config.title: Overview
config.content:
## Contoso .NET APM lab — Profiler vs EDOT

**Live layout:**
- `ShipmentsWeb` → SharedPool + **Elastic APM profiler** (`agent.name=dotnet`) → `traces-apm*`
- `TrackingApi-EDOT` → TrackingEdotPool + **EDOT** (`agent.name=opentelemetry/dotnet/elastic`) → `traces-generic.otel-default`

Business spans: Fody weave (`app`/`business` or OTel `Internal` via `Contoso.Observability`).

data_source.query: FROM traces-apm-default | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 7 days AND service.name IN ("ShipmentsWeb","TrackingApi") | STATS docs = COUNT(*)
FROM traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 7 days AND service.name == "TrackingApi-EDOT" | STATS docs = COUNT(*)

FROM traces-apm-default, traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 7 days AND service.name IN ("ShipmentsWeb","TrackingApi","TrackingApi-EDOT") | STATS docs = COUNT(*) BY agent.name | SORT docs DESC
FROM traces-apm-default | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 7 days AND service.name == "ShipmentsWeb" | STATS docs = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 hour) | SORT time_bucket ASC
FROM traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 7 days AND service.name == "TrackingApi-EDOT" | STATS docs = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 hour) | SORT time_bucket ASC
FROM traces-apm-default | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 24 hours AND service.name == "ShipmentsWeb" AND processor.event == "span" | STATS docs = COUNT(*) BY span.type | SORT docs DESC
FROM traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 24 hours AND service.name == "TrackingApi-EDOT" | STATS docs = COUNT(*) BY kind | SORT docs DESC
FROM traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 24 hours AND service.name == "TrackingApi-EDOT" | STATS docs = COUNT(*) BY scope.name | SORT docs DESC

config.title: Capability matrix
config.content:
### Capability matrix

| Dimension | Profiler (.NET APM agent) | EDOT (.NET) |
|---|---|---|
| Intake | APM server (`.apm`) | Managed OTLP (`.ingest`) |
| Data stream | `traces-apm*` / dataset `apm` | `traces-*.otel*` / `generic.otel` |
| HTTP server | APM transactions | OTel Server spans (AspNet instrumentation) |
| SQL | `span.type=db` / mssql | SqlClient Client spans |
| Business/Fody | `app` / `business` | `Internal` ActivitySource |
| Stacktraces | Yes | Not available |
| Central/dynamic config | Yes | Not available |
| Span compression | Yes | Not implemented |
| IIS model | COR profiler on pool | NuGet + TelemetryHttpModule; **separate pool** |

config.title: Overhead summary
config.content:
### Weave / profiler overhead (10m @ 10 req/s k6)

| Stage | med | p95 | checks |
|---|---|---|---|
| B0 (no weave, no profiler) | 43.3ms | 101ms | 100% |
| S1 (no weave + profiler) | 40.0ms | 101ms | 100% |
| narrow (`*Service` only) | 46.8ms | 111ms | 100% |
| broad (+ Pricing/CallChain/Repo) | 40.6ms | 111ms | 100% |
